title: Eyes of Wakanda opens the historical record
summary: Wakandan warriors protect vibranium across earlier eras, establishing Wakanda as a hidden power whose history reaches into the modern MCU.

title: Steve Rogers becomes Captain America
summary: Steve Rogers receives the super-soldier serum, fights HYDRA with Peggy Carter and Bucky Barnes, and disappears while saving the world.

title: Peggy Carter builds the SSR
summary: After the war, Peggy Carter works through the SSR and the early intelligence networks that eventually lead toward S.H.I.E.L.D.

title: Carol Danvers returns to Earth
summary: Carol Danvers discovers the truth about the Kree–Skrull conflict, becomes Captain Marvel, and gives Nick Fury the idea for a wider hero initiative.

title: Tony Stark becomes Iron Man
summary: Tony Stark builds armor to escape captivity, turns away from weapons dealing, and becomes the first public face of the modern superhero age.

title: Fury's Big Week gathers the future Avengers
summary: Stark Industries, S.H.I.E.L.D., Asgard, and gamma science collide as Thor arrives on Earth and Bruce Banner remains a fugitive.

title: The Avengers form against Loki
summary: Nick Fury's initiative finally works: Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow, and Hawkeye unite to stop Loki's invasion of New York.

title: The Infinity Stones enter the open conflict
summary: Thor and Jane Foster encounter the Aether while Tony Stark processes the Battle of New York and the Ten Rings story moves toward its hidden power.

title: HYDRA falls and the Winter Soldier returns
summary: Steve Rogers and Natasha Romanoff expose HYDRA inside S.H.I.E.L.D.; Bucky Barnes survives as the Winter Soldier and begins the road back to himself.

title: The Guardians of the Galaxy assemble
summary: Peter Quill, Gamora, Rocket, Groot, and Drax become an unlikely team around the Power Stone and the threat of Thanos.

title: The Guardians survive Ego
summary: Mantis joins the Guardians, Quill meets his Celestial father Ego, and the team's found family is tested by grief, betrayal, and Yondu's sacrifice.

title: New York's street-level heroes emerge
summary: Daredevil and Jessica Jones establish the Defenders corner of the shared world, where law, trauma, and organized crime matter as much as cosmic threats.

title: The Avengers defeat Ultron
summary: The Avengers' attempt to automate global defense creates Ultron, while Wanda and Vision enter the story and the team saves Sokovia at enormous cost.

title: Scott Lang becomes Ant-Man
summary: Scott Lang inherits Hank Pym's shrinking technology, partners with Hope van Dyne, and opens the Quantum Realm thread that later saves the Avengers.

title: The Defenders unite against the Hand
summary: Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage, and Iron Fist briefly combine, pulling New York's separate vigilante stories into one MCU street-level network.

title: The Avengers fracture in Civil War
summary: The Sokovia Accords and Bucky's past split Steve Rogers from Tony Stark; T'Challa, Spider-Man, Black Panther, and Black Widow are pulled into the conflict.

title: Natasha and Yelena dismantle the Red Room
summary: Natasha Romanoff reunites with Yelena, Alexei, and Melina to free the surviving Black Widows and end the Red Room's control.

title: Wakanda opens its borders
summary: T'Challa defeats Killmonger, chooses outreach over secrecy, and makes Wakanda's vibranium and political choices central to the wider MCU.

title: Spider-Man balances school and hero work
summary: Peter Parker tries to prove himself to Tony Stark while protecting Queens, with May, MJ, and Ned anchoring his ordinary life.

title: Stephen Strange enters the mystic arts
summary: A car accident redirects Stephen Strange to Kamar-Taj, where Wong and the Ancient One teach him to defend reality from Dormammu.

title: Daredevil and Punisher collide
summary: Frank Castle's lethal war on crime challenges Matt Murdock's code, while Karen Page becomes a bridge between their competing ideas of justice.

title: Asgard falls and New Asgard begins
summary: Thor, Loki, Valkyrie, and Bruce Banner survive Hela and Ragnarok, but Asgard's refugees are intercepted by Thanos.

title: The Quantum Realm becomes a doorway
summary: Scott, Hope, Hank, and Janet rescue Janet from the Quantum Realm, just before the Blip interrupts their return.

title: Thanos collects the Infinity Stones
summary: Thanos defeats heroes across Earth and space, kills Loki and Gamora, and uses the completed Gauntlet to erase half of all life.

title: The Avengers undo the Blip
summary: The surviving Avengers use the Quantum Realm for a time heist, Hulk restores the vanished, and Tony Stark sacrifices himself to defeat Thanos.

title: The TVA captures a branching Loki
summary: The 2012 Loki variant meets Mobius and Sylvie, learns the TVA is built on a lie, and watches Sylvie kill He Who Remains to release branching timelines.

title: Wanda creates and breaks Westview
summary: Wanda Maximoff's grief reshapes a town, Vision returns in two forms, and Billy's magical family thread begins before the Hex collapses.

title: Shang-Chi takes the Ten Rings
summary: Shang-Chi and Katy return to Ta Lo, defeat Wenwu's obsession, and leave Xialing in charge of the Ten Rings.

links.label: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

title: Sam Wilson accepts the shield
summary: Sam becomes Captain America, Bucky confronts his past, and their partnership faces a world of flagsmashers, governments, and the Power Broker.

links.label: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

title: Peter Parker loses his mentor
summary: Peter and his classmates travel abroad, defeat Mysterio, and learn that the world now knows Spider-Man's identity while Talos impersonates Nick Fury.

title: The Eternals stop the Emergence
summary: Sersi, Thena, and Phastos turn against the Celestial plan, using the Uni-Mind to save Earth while their family splits across the cosmos.

title: Three Spider-Men share one crisis
summary: Strange's spell pulls Peter Parker variants and their villains into the MCU main universe; Peter chooses sacrifice and sends every visitor home.

title: Strange crosses Earth-838
summary: Doctor Strange and America Chavez travel between universes, meet the Earth-838 Illuminati, and confront Wanda's multiverse pursuit.

links.label: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

title: Kate Bishop enters the Hawkeye legacy
summary: Clint Barton confronts his Ronin history, Kate Bishop becomes his partner, and Maya Lopez breaks from Fisk's orbit.

title: Moon Knight awakens the Egyptian gods
summary: Marc Spector and Steven Grant share a body, Layla becomes Scarlet Scarab, and Khonshu's conflict pulls the MCU into an ancient supernatural pantheon.

title: Shuri inherits the Black Panther mantle
summary: Wakanda mourns T'Challa, Shuri becomes Black Panther, and a conflict with Namor ends in a careful alliance between Wakanda and Talokan.

title: Echo breaks from Kingpin
summary: Maya Lopez returns home, confronts the legacy Fisk placed on her, and reconnects with Choctaw family and inherited power.

title: The next generation expands
summary: Jennifer Walters brings superhuman law into the everyday world while Kamala Khan's story begins the young-hero network around Captain Marvel.

title: Jane Foster wields Mjolnir
summary: Thor faces Gorr with Jane Foster as the Mighty Thor, while Valkyrie and the Guardians connect Asgard's story to the cosmic frontier.

title: Ironheart follows Wakanda's technology thread
summary: Riri Williams turns invention into a new hero identity, extending the technology and magic tensions introduced through Wakanda Forever.

title: The monster underground is revealed
summary: Jack Russell and Elsa Bloodstone survive a supernatural hunt, introducing the MCU's monster corner without leaving the shared main universe.

title: The Guardians return to Earth
summary: The Guardians celebrate together, with Mantis and Drax trying to give Peter Quill a holiday that acknowledges his lost Earth life.

links.label: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special

title: The Ant-Man family enters the Quantum Realm
summary: Scott, Hope, Janet, Hank, and Cassie meet Kang's larger threat in the Quantum Realm and escape with the multiverse danger still unresolved.

title: Rocket leads a new Guardians
summary: The Guardians save Rocket from the High Evolutionary, close the old chapter, and leave Rocket, Groot, and Adam Warlock leading a new team.

title: Secret Invasion exposes a Skrull war
summary: Nick Fury and Talos confront a radicalized Skrull movement, while G'iah's new powers turn the conflict into a global security crisis.

title: The Marvels link three heroes
summary: Carol Danvers, Monica Rambeau, and Kamala Khan swap places through entangled powers, while the crisis leaves Monica in a parallel universe.

title: Loki becomes the keeper of timelines
summary: Loki, Sylvie, Mobius, and B-15 fight to save branching realities; Loki takes the burden of holding the timelines together.

title: Deadpool crosses the Fox corridor
summary: Wade Wilson is pulled into the TVA and the Void, recruits a Wolverine variant, and turns Fox's X-Men and Fantastic Four legacies into a multiverse story.

title: Agatha and Billy walk the Witches' Road
summary: Agatha Harkness returns to magic, while Billy Maximoff's search for Tommy continues the Maximoff family story after Westview.

title: Daredevil: Born Again reopens Hell's Kitchen
summary: Matt Murdock, Wilson Fisk, Karen Page, and Frank Castle pull the Defenders legacy into the current MCU street-level power struggle.

title: Sam Wilson leads a new Captain America era
summary: Sam Wilson faces a geopolitical crisis as Captain America, while Isaiah Bradley and the shadow of government-controlled super-soldiers remain central.

title: The Thunderbolts become a team
summary: Yelena, Bucky, U.S. Agent, Red Guardian, Valentina, and Bob Reynolds converge, survive the Void crisis, and become an uneasy New Avengers generation.

title: The First Steps universe faces Galactus
summary: A retro-futuristic Fantastic Four defend their alternate universe from Galactus and his herald Shalla-Bal, distinct from Earth-838 and the MCU main continuity.

title: Wonder Man widens the MCU's story
summary: The post-Endgame MCU continues beyond the Avengers succession, adding another connected hero and Hollywood-facing corner to the main timeline.

title: Born Again season 2 continues the street war
summary: Daredevil, Kingpin, Karen, and Punisher carry the guide's chronology into its most recent street-level chapter.

title: The Punisher: One Last Kill closes the guide
summary: Frank Castle's latest story remains a street-level counterpoint to Daredevil's code and the larger MCU's succession of heroes.
